verifyNote: Bounties are our own: each reuses a road encounter (its usual XP) plus a small quest award and a purse. Gold is our pick for the act [inferred].

bounties.poster: REWARD 25 gp. Stirges nesting in the reeds below Varrow's Mill have bled two mules white. Kill the lot.
REWARD 50 gp. Robbers on the Ashwood track, five at least, masked. Two carts taken this tenday. Bring them in or drive them off.
REWARD 100 gp. A griffon has taken nine goats from the hills above the old mine. It will take a child next. Kill it or drive it off.
REWARD 300 gp. Four bandits camped at the edge of the Forgotten Forest. Dead or alive. Apply to the Grey Company.
REWARD 80 gp. Giant spiders across the marsh paths. The lizardfolk will thank you; the Hall will pay you.
REWARD 100 gp. Two ghouls on the Marrowmere causeway. Don't get scratched.
REWARD 150 gp. An owlbear holds the pass road. Evacuees need that road. Hurry.
REWARD 250 gp. A troll under the old bridge below the Great Forge. Bring fire. Bring a lot of fire.
